title: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission UPESSC Principal Recruitment 2026 : Admit Card for 111 Post
organization: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
vacancyDetails: 111 Principal vacancies in Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) recruitment 2026.
qualification: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) degree and 15 years of experience as per UPESSC Principal advertisement 02/2026. Read the official notification for detailed eligibility and subject-specific conditions.
ageLimit: Maximum age: 62 years for male as on 01/06/2026; age relaxation as per UPESSC recruitment rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹3000; SC / ST / PH: ₹3000. Pay the fee through online or offline mode as per official instructions.
selectionProcess: Online Application → Written Examination → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, Ph.D. degree, experience certificate, photograph, signature, ID proof, category certificate as applicable, and required documents mentioned in the official notification

1. Visit the official UPESSC portal or the principal recruitment application link
2. Complete one-time registration, if required
3. Fill all personal, academic and experience details carefully
4. Upload the required documents and pay the fee
5. Verify the preview and submit the application
6. Save a printout of the final submitted form
shortDescription: UPESSC has released the Principal Recruitment 2026 notification for 111 posts. Eligible candidates can apply online from 21 July 2026 to 20 August 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has issued the Principal Recruitment 2026 notification under Advt. No. 02/2026.

Interested candidates can submit the application form from 21/07/2026 to 20/08/2026. The examination date is 24/09/2026, exam city details were released on 14/09/2026, and admit cards are expected on 21/09/2026.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 21/07/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20/08/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 20/08/2026
  • Correction Last Date: 23/08/2026
  • Principal Exam Date: 24/09/2026
  • Exam City Available: 14/09/2026
  • Admit Card Available: 21/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹3000
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹3000

Age Limit

Maximum age: 62 years for male as on 01/06/2026. Age relaxation is as per UPESSC rules.

Vacancy Details

  • Total Posts: 111
  • Post Name: Principal

Educational eligibility requires a Ph.D. degree and 15 years of experience. Detailed post-wise conditions are available in the official UPESSC notification.
